entries.title: Code Cubes That Rewrite Themselves
entries.description: A cluster of labeled translucent cubes (code blocks) float in a light space, periodically splitting, merging, and changing color while glowing connector lines rewire between them to show “self-modification” events.

entries.title: Program DNA Helix Rewriting
entries.description: A tall semi-transparent double-helix made of colored spheres (instructions) slowly rotates, and certain spheres detach, slide along rails, and reinsert at new positions, with color changes and brief flashes marking each modification.

entries.title: Neural Network That Rewires Itself
